messages.text:
Hi Ops, request for a 90-day pilot.
Vendor legal name: Figma, Inc.
Website: https://www.figma.com
Touches customer data: No. Only internal product mockups with placeholder data, no customer records.
Business owner: Marcus Bell, Product Design Lead
Target start date: 2026-10-26
About 5 designer seats.

touches_customer_data.raw_text: No. Only internal product mockups with placeholder data, no customer records.

context.use_case: Internal product UI mockups with placeholder data [SYNTHESIZED]

rows.value: Figma, Inc. Legal notices go to 760 Market St, Floor 10, San Francisco, CA 94102.
rows.label: PUBLIC

rows.value: Collaborative design platform: Figma Design for UI design and prototyping, Dev Mode for handoff, FigJam whiteboards, Slides, Make, and more. Sold per seat per month (Full, Dev and Collab seats).
rows.label: PUBLIC

rows.value: "Customer Content" = materials developed on or uploaded to Figma by the customer or its Authorized Users. Account information = name, email address, picture. For this pilot: 5 Acme designer accounts (names and work emails) and internal mockups with placeholder data. No Acme customer records.
rows.label: PUBLIC

rows.value: Security page lists SOC 2 Type 2, SOC 3, ISO 27001:2022, 27017, 27018, 27701, ISO 42001 (AI), EU Cloud Code of Conduct, C5, TISAX, CSA CAIQ and FedRAMP Authorized, plus a bug bounty. The DPA commits to encryption at rest and in transit (TLS/SSL and AES-256 or equivalent).
rows.label: PUBLIC

rows.value: The SOC 2 Type 2 report is not public. The security page points to Figma's Trust Center for compliance documents, and the DPA says Figma shares summaries of its certifications and audit reports on written request, subject to confidentiality controls. A person must request it.
rows.label: PUBLIC

rows.value: Public list with activity, location and data categories; customers can subscribe to changes, and new sub-processors are listed at least 15 days before they start. Includes AWS (US, or the selected region on Enterprise), Cloudflare, Datadog, Sentry, Snowflake, Twilio, AI model providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Vertex, Azure and others), support vendors, and Figma group companies.
rows.label: PUBLIC

rows.value: Only on the Enterprise plan: file content can be hosted on AWS in the US, EU, Australia, India, Brazil, Japan or Canada. Billing data, metadata, logs and user profiles are not covered, and new edits may sit in the US for up to 30 days. Other plans are hosted in the US.
rows.label: PUBLIC

rows.value: SAML SSO (Okta, Entra ID, OneLogin, Google Workspace, AD FS or custom SAML 2.0) and SCIM are only on Organization and Enterprise. 2FA works on any plan but is set per account; enforcing it for everyone needs Governance+ on Enterprise.
rows.label: PUBLIC

rows.value: Public DPA with Figma, Inc. (last updated March 30, 2026); includes EU SCCs and a UK addendum. Figma must notify the customer of a security incident without undue delay and, where feasible, within 72 hours. Customer content is deleted or returned within 30 days after the service ends.
rows.label: PUBLIC

rows.value: Per seat per month: Professional on monthly billing $20 Full, $15 Dev, $5 Collab ($16 / $12 / $3 on annual billing). Organization $55 / $25 / $5 and Enterprise $90 / $35 / $5 are billed annually only; Enterprise also says "Contact sales". Starter is free.
rows.label: PUBLIC

rows.value: 5 Full seats x $20 x 3 months on Professional monthly billing: about $300. Professional is the only plan billed monthly; Organization and Enterprise need an annual commitment. Excludes extra AI credits and add-ons. Professional has no SAML SSO (see R8).
rows.label: ASSUMPTION

rows.value: Third-party model providers may not train on customer data. Figma itself trains its own models on customer content when the admin content-training setting is on: on by default for Starter and Professional (admins can opt out), off by default for Organization and Enterprise.
rows.label: PUBLIC

pack.summary_for_approvers: Figma, Inc. is a widely used design and prototyping platform. For this pilot it would hold only 5 Acme designers' accounts and internal mockups with placeholder data, so no Acme customer data and no Security review. Its security posture is strong: SOC 2 Type 2 (report on request), several ISO certifications, a public sub-processor list and a public DPA with 72-hour breach notice, but SAML SSO needs a higher plan and Figma trains its own AI on Professional content unless an admin turns that off. Estimated cost for 5 Full seats for 90 days on Professional monthly billing is about $300.
